design.opponent_trace: same frozen exogenous three-regime generator as v0.3; replayed identically across estimators

estimators.control_full_history: mean of all prior opponent allocations
estimators.control_change_point: L1 two-window shift detector; window=8, threshold=4 troops; reset to most recent detected segment

design.prespecified_success_rule: at least one recency-aware estimator improves 16-round post-switch payoff over full-history by >=0.02 while overall payoff is no worse by more than 0.02

claim_scope: Control-estimator mechanism ablation under fixed nonstationary replay; not observational construct recovery
